_comment: redirects: these paths live on the app (app.wavehubtennis.com), not on this
static marketing site, so they used to 404 here. People type them anyway.
permanent is deliberately false (307, not a cached 308): a permanent
redirect would be pinned in visitors' browsers and could not be undone if
any of these ever becomes a real page on the marketing site.
/apply no longer exists on the app either — the application funnel was
removed — so it points at signup rather than at a fresh 404.
rewrites: serve the free-group page at a clean /free without renaming the
file or turning on cleanUrls, which would also rewrite the legal pages.
